verdicts.originalText: On cast, heals the whole party based on Sayu's ATK. The Muji-Muji Daruma then heals the lowest-HP active character roughly every 1.5s — but only while that character is at 70% HP or lower (or when no enemies are nearby); otherwise it attacks enemies instead. At Constellation 1 it can heal and attack at the same time.
verdicts.proposedText: The Daruma's heal is shown on every tick, but against enemies it only heals while the active character is at 70% HP or lower — otherwise it attacks, which is not modeled. At C1 it does both at once.
verdicts.rationale: The heal's HP condition (recipientHpBelow:70) renders optimistically by design, and the mutually-exclusive attack tick is not authored — a legitimate optimistic-condition + omission caveat, so keep/rewrite never implementDelete. Compressed to the two real divergences (heal shown every tick vs in-combat 70% gate; unmodeled attack alternation; C1 removes the gate). Dropped the opening on-cast party-heal sentence as working behavior (target 'team', onCast, ATK-scaled effect renders correctly) and the 'lowest-HP' targeting nuance (tool approximates with target 'active'). Names Sayu and the summon proper noun 'Daruma'; Sayu's name removed per no-names rule, Daruma retained as a kit proper noun that disambiguates the summon heal from the cast heal. 'not modeled' spelling, under soft cap, two sentences.

claimsLost.claim: On cast, heals the whole party based on Sayu's ATK.
The Daruma heals the lowest-HP active character specifically.
It also heals when no enemies are nearby, even above 70% HP.

demotedNotes: Summon periodic heal targets the active character; in game it selects the lowest-HP-percentage active character nearby, which is not an expressible targeting primitive (already noted in existing curator residuals).
